CA.rationale: No explicit attention/content-processing relation present for the identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (red assignment), its presentation/access labeling (p0/current), and a separate origin/status field are all explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation statement linking processing to the identified content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: The report identifies specific content (red) and its location for a named referent and time.

D.rationale: An origin/status field is provided separately from the content assignment, distinguishing identification from status/organization.

O.rationale: The 'p0/current' labeling and explicit coordinate listing state how the content is presented/accessible for that referent/time.
